name: Spaghetti Pomodoro
description: Simple spaghetti in a garlicky fresh-basil tomato sauce.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Warm the olive oil in a wide pan and gently fry the sliced garlic until fragrant, not brown.
Add the tomatoes, crush them with a spoon, season with salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente and reserve a cup of pasta water.
Toss the pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water, then tear in the basil and serve.
